# UI copy cleanup screenshots

Each numbered before/after pair shows one cleanup. Both calculators have their
own instruction and date-field comparisons. The thirteenth pair covers the
contradictory saved indicator after reverting a failed edit.

- Baseline: `ec05f3fc210cb4648cc1195d87360bdd5657e038`.
- Runtime: the repository's Microsoft.Playwright Chromium and isolated ASP.NET
  Core browser-test application, at 1280 × 1000, light mode, `en-US`, and
  `Asia/Singapore`.
- Check-in clock: 2026-07-01 06:00 UTC; participant and submissions are synthetic.
- Images are direct browser screenshots, cropped to the relevant component.
  Natural height changes remain visible.
- The first twelve baseline views were captured before editing the source.
  The failure/reversion baseline replays that commit's original compiled
  check-in script and stylesheet against the same synthetic fixture.

The PR description presents every pair side by side. No production submissions
or payments were made to generate these images.
